wrappers.purpose: Lane entry point: runs run-analysis.R, then verification-aids.R, as two separate R processes.

Runs deposit/Herskind&Riede_S2.R byte-identical through the lane's evaluator (run_file, tolerate = 27L, encoding UTF-8) with the working directory set to deposit/ and a cairo PNG default graphics device; afterwards writes the authors' objects (Table 1 and 2 values, Fig. 2 and Fig. 3 plot data, matrix m, objects for the aids) under captured/ without recomputation.

Labelled verification aids under ruling R1: read-only lookups in S1 and documented quanteda/readxl/ggplot2 calls on the authors' saved objects, for targets with no authors' code (T01 map, T03 boxes, T04, T07, T09, T10, T13, T14, T16, T17, T18).

Build-time only: installs the seven README pins from CRAN tarballs and their unspecified dependencies from the Posit Package Manager snapshot of 2024-04-03, with the capped version search and an asserted inventory.
Image definition: rocker/r-ver:4.3.2, UTF-8 locale, system libraries, install-pins.R.

Host-side comparison after the final run: reads only the sealed outputs of run-05, the transcriptions in published-values/, and the deposited S3.xlsx; compares values and writes the per-target detail files and summary.json under comparisons/. Runs no authors' code and recomputes no analysis.
Transcription aid run on the host before any run: measures bar totals and chronology segments of the published Fig. 3 (and the Fig. 2 bar panel) from pixel colours. Reads only the published figure.
Transcription aid run on the host before any run: detects the small culture-exclusive boxes on the published Fig. 4 from pixel colours. Reads only the published figure.

notes: All four files of Zenodo record 10801706 were downloaded on 2026-10-17 and matched Zenodo's published md5 checksums at retrieval. S1.xlsx is the analysis input and S3.xlsx the published reference for T08; README.txt is the environment statement. Only S2.R is code; it is executed in place (deposit/) and never edited.
